# SQLCipher 4 Bot stores (Task 6b)

`clean/` and `hot-wal/` are Bot state directories written by the SQLCipher build before the native
store moved to SQLite3 Multiple Ciphers (binding 1/2/3, test key `0x41` × 32). How they were made,
what they hold and their hashes: `core/dilla-core/tests/fixtures/sqlcipher4/README.md`.
